purpose: Measure F_NP identifiability without confounding the fitted core with a remote transform-closure coordinate.

gates.reported_region: x=0.1 and bT<=2 GeV^-1 with median F_NP>0.05
gates.extension_rule: Extend to at least 12 independent basins only if the three-start test preserves fit quality and materially improves F_NP stability.

interpretation: Transform closure and Fourier-tail handling are downstream numerical questions and are deliberately absent from this DNN-core identifiability test.
